claims.assertion: Mari reports that Etorthan Federation representatives met Earth Cabal members in Antarctica and left an undisclosed number of diplomats aboard the biosphere ship Viera on a continuing basis.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the meeting agenda and authority for the permanent posting were not disclosed.

claims.assertion: Mari distinguishes multiple Federation levels, saying the loving, noninterventionist version belongs to a lighter astral level, while lower levels include diverse groups and political complexity.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She argues that permitting embodied suffering remains unethical from the individual perspective.

review_flags: source chronology: title dates update 31 Jan 2024; p0004 says Etorthan arrived 31 Dec 2024 before meetings on 27–28 Jan 2024
coverage_gaps: alleged annual visits and Earth political developments
